remarks: Exceptional Side-by-Side Duplex in the heart of Glenbrook!  Discover the perfect blend of comfort and convenience in this impressive two-family home, nestled in the vibrant Glenbrook neighborhood. Each unit in this duplex-style residence spans three levels, offering a harmonious balance of privacy and space, ideal for both owner-occupants and savvy investors.  As you step inside, you'll be greeted by a warm and inviting atmosphere, accentuated by gleaming hardwood floors that flow seamlessly throughout the well-designed layout. The spacious kitchens are a delight, opening up to cozy dining areas, perfect for hosting dinner parties or enjoying everyday meals. The living rooms are bathed in natural light, creating an inviting space for relaxation and entertainment.  Each unit features a convenient half bath on the main level, while the second floors boast three generously sized bedrooms and a full bath, providing ample room for families or guests. The homes have been nicely updated and maintained, ensuring a turnkey experience complete with the added convenience of in-unit washers and dryers.  Step outside to enjoy the charming porch areas and the shared backyard space, where you can savor the outdoors and create lasting memories. This property's prime location is just a stone's throw away from local train stations and shops, with the bustling downtown Stamford nearby, offering a plethora of dining, shopping and entertainment options.
